## Changes (file:line)

- **`cart/editor/stage/BuildBar.tsx`** (new, now committed) — rewritten tray: each piece renders a `PieceThumb` (lines 57-79), a static `Scene3D` product shot with the auto-framed 3/4 orbit camera, identical lighting/backdrop to the library's ModelThumbnail. `thumbViewFor` (lines 36-54) dispatches: **authored (`model:`) pieces** photograph their real stored mesh via `authoredMeshData(modelId, pkgId)` → `buildPartsThumbView`; **catalog pieces** photograph their triangulated `pieceVisualShapes` decomposition. Views cached once per session (module `VIEW_CACHE`); a null view (host-only authored mesh, geometry not resident) falls back to the flat swatch — honest fallback only, not the default path, and it is not cached so it upgrades once the package loads.
- **`cart/editor/world/pieceThumbMesh.ts`** (new) — `catalogPieceThumbParts(pieceId)`: triangulates the piece's real decomposition (window jamb/sill/header + translucent glass pane, door/garage leaves, roof wedges, stair steps, elevator frames) into interleaved `[px,py,pz,nx,ny,nz,u,v]` meshes, grouped per (color, opacity) since a Scene3D.Mesh carries one material; opaque parts sorted before translucent. CCW winding verified against 3d.zig's `cull_mode = .back, front_face = .ccw`; yaw honored (gable slopeB is yaw-180).
- **`cart/editor/library/modelThumb.ts:56-92`** — extended (only) with `ThumbPart`/`PartsThumbView` + `buildPartsThumbView`: frames the shared product-shot camera on the union AABB of multiple parts; `meshBounds` refactored onto a shared `scanBounds`.
- **`cart/editor/workspace.cls.ts:236-246`** — appended (never restructured) `HW_BuildTray` (maxHeight 195 = 3 tile rows, overflow hidden — bar can't swallow the viewport), `HW_BuildPieceTile/On` (fixed 64×60), `HW_BuildPieceThumb` (42×42), `HW_BuildPieceTileLabelBox/Label/LabelOn` (`noWrap`, `numberOfLines: 1` — labels truncate, never wrap). Old chip classes left untouched.

**Approach**: catalog pieces got REAL geometry thumbs through the same pipeline — no CSS-box stopgap was needed.

## Verification

- `SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship editor` — clean.
- Shot: `/tmp/claude-1000/-home-siah-creative-reactjit/a29bdf2b-cd53-4650-be3f-08a38fb3ab80/scratchpad/y_buildbar.png` — **visible**: build bar open on the Floor category (armed from persisted state); both tiles show real shaded 3D plate renders (grey concrete plate, brown wood plate) at the product-shot angle with truncated labels below; armed tile carries the primary border. Not color chips.
- The shot only exercises the Floor category (RJIT_EDKEYS has no category-click driver), so I additionally ran the triangulator headlessly under v8cli for wall/window/doorway/gable/ramp/stairs: all parts finite, unit normals, correct bounds (wall 3×3×0.005, gable rise 0.75), window wall = 2 parts with the glass pane at opacity 0.3 sorted last, doorway = wall + dark leaf.
